description: Destinatarios de residuos peligrosos is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría del Medio Ambiente. La transferencia de contaminantes se define como el “traslado de contaminantes a un lugar que se encuentra físicamente separado del establecimiento que lo generó”. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría del Medio Ambiente. Its tags are Descargas de aguas residuales al alcantarillado publico, Dsiposicion de residuos peligrosos en sitios de seguridad, Transferencias fuera de sitio. It offers 20 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
